description: We are a team of passionate innovators, developers, and problem-solvers interested in technology, AI, space exploration, and Earth science. We welcome developers, designers, researchers, scientists, and creative thinkers to collaborate, share skills, and build impactful solutions using NASA's open data. Together, we aim to solve real-world challenges through innovation and teamwork.
summary:
AstroHealth is an independent student innovation prototype designed to support astronaut health monitoring during space missions. It provides a centralized platform for viewing vital-sign trends, monitoring sleep patterns, recording wellbeing observations, tracking radiation records and reviewing health alerts.

The platform includes an AI-assisted health information feature that summarizes available records and highlights observations for review. It also connects users with NASA space-life-science research resources to support future research-data integration.

Built with React, TypeScript and Python FastAPI, AstroHealth aims to make astronaut health information easier to access, understand and monitor, contributing to better health awareness during long-duration space missions.

Demonstration records are simulated, not real astronaut medical records. AstroHealth is an educational prototype, not a certified medical device or an official NASA product.
details:
AstroHealth – Intelligent Health Monitoring Beyond Earth is an independent student innovation prototype developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, Challenge 5: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions.

AstroHealth provides a centralized platform for monitoring astronaut health information, including vital-sign trends, sleep patterns, wellbeing records, radiation records and health alerts. It also features an AI-assisted health information assistant that summarizes available records and highlights observations for review.

The platform is built with React, TypeScript and Python FastAPI, with interactive charts and a mission-control-inspired interface.

AstroHealth aims to demonstrate how digital health monitoring and space-life-science research can support astronaut health awareness and mission operations during long-duration space missions.

The current demonstration uses simulated records, not real astronaut medical data. AstroHealth is an educational prototype and is not an official NASA product or certified medical device.
